definitions.explanation: A two-piece swimsuit consisting of a top and bottom. Loanword from English, used the same way as in English. Considered a more revealing style of {水着|みずぎ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ビキニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧ビキニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いだ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: I wore a white bikini and swam in the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧、⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧なビキニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a stylish bikini for summer vacation.

notes:
Loanword from English "bikini." Refers to the two-piece swimsuit style; can be replaced by the longer ビキニ⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水着|みずぎ}→水着：00286_mizugi⟧ when contrast with one-piece styles is needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビキニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a bikini
- ビキニ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: bikini-clad figure
- ハイウエストビキニ: high-waisted bikini
- ビキニ⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧ / ビキニボトム: bikini top / bottom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水着|みずぎ}→水着：00286_mizugi⟧: swimsuit — general term; includes bikinis, one-pieces, and trunks
- ⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦{水着|みずぎ}→水着：00286_mizugi⟧: one-piece swimsuit — explicit contrast term
- タンキニ: tankini — bikini bottom with a longer tank-style top
